The turtle features a dark, high-domed shell heavily covered in green algae/moss, obscuring the underlying surface texture. The head is dark with distinct yellow linear markings/stripes on the neck and face. Visible forelimbs show webbed feet and claws digging into the sand. The background is blurred sand.
